BL-0.1.4-004-S13.title: Tool Router and Debug Logger Integration for Audit Events
BL-0.1.4-004-S13.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and debug_logger so that every tool invocation, input validation, and result is captured as an audit event with correlation_id propagation across the request lifecycle.

BL-0.1.4-004-S14.title: FastAPI Middleware for End-to-End Audit Capture
BL-0.1.4-004-S14.description: Implement FastAPI middleware in main.py to automatically log request start, response completion, errors, and latency as audit events, ensuring full lifecycle traceability for every API interaction.

BL-0.1.4-004-S15.title: Audit Logging Performance and Throughput Validation
BL-0.1.4-004-S15.description: Design and execute performance tests to validate that append-only audit logging does not exceed acceptable latency thresholds under concurrent load, including batching and write efficiency validation.

BL-0.1.4-004-S16.title: Migration and Backfill of Existing Debug Logs into Audit Format
BL-0.1.4-004-S16.description: Implement a one-time migration utility to transform existing debug_logger records into the new append-only audit log schema, ensuring continuity of historical traceability without violating immutability constraints.
